nuggets.text: Head coach Ken Niumatalolo is the first ethnic Samoan to be a college head coach at any level.
Ken Niumatalolo quarterbacked Hawai'i to its first postseason bowl game in 1989.
Ken Niumatalolo won 109 games at Navy, the most in that program's history.
Super Bowl-winning coaches Bill Walsh and Dick Vermeil both played quarterback for the Spartans.
Trajan Sinatra, the Mountain West Special Teams Player of the Week, is a perfect 3-for-3 on field goals this season.
CEFCU Stadium opened in 1933 with just 4,000 seats and later hosted the 1999 FIFA Women's World Cup.
In 2024, Nick Nash became the first Spartan ever named both a consensus and unanimous All-American.
The Spartans opened with two road games for the first time since 2011.
Luke Weaver leads the Mountain West with 5 touchdown passes and 550 passing yards.
The Spartans have forced a takeaway in 22 of 27 games under Ken Niumatalolo.
